## Known biases

All FEMA facts come from Internet Archive copies (secondary): news page snapshot 2025-09-14, BCA landing page snapshot 2026-10-31. The standard useful-life table was not located. The statement applies to Hazard Mitigation Assistance projects not obligated before 2025-04-08 and to Public Assistance projects not awarded by that date.
